reason: Verified (22:46 UTC 25 Sep). The GPU quota rose from 18:56 at 13:58 (CONTEXT l.1745) to 21:13 at 18:12 (lens_redteam-plan.notes l.19): +2.28 h. The known GPU sessions in that window explain it: K2 dummy 0.42 h + K1 0.47 h + FD/FF ~0.3-0.4 h each + exp60 shard A 17:15-18:10 = 0.92 h, total ~2.4-2.6 h. The finding actually understates the case. Besides P36 (~1.9 h), the #35 hidden rerun (to ~16:16, ~2.3 h in the window) and the #34 rerun (to ~14:36, ~0.6 h) also ran, so counted reruns would have added ~4.8 h. Hidden reruns are therefore almost certainly not charged, and K2, the twin and the finals submissions do not depend on the quota. Every consumer of round-2 A5 is gone: the twin dummy is COMPLETE (exp58n v1, 20:35Z), K3/K3b were closed by the T9 read (da154cb), and L6 was conditional on K3b. Even if no reset happens, ~5 h of this week's quota remain after exp60 A/B and the twin. That is enough for any conceivable 0.3-0.5 h re-dummy (e.g. an OK'd floatout rider), so the quota is non-binding either way. Value: 0 on LB/private; this is a process simplification. It does remove a task from the busy 00:00:30-00:05 K2 submit window. Feasibility: trivial, no code, no rule touched.
fix: Downgrade R2-A5-quota-check from a mandatory ~00:05 step to optional: read https://www.kaggle.com/settings once on 26 Sep (e.g. with the morning brief) and log W06 (reset yes/no, hours used). Also add one line to CONTEXT: hidden reruns empirically do not consume GPU quota (13:58->18:12 delta +2.28 h vs ~4.8 h of #34/#35/#36 reruns in the window). Do not let a quota reset trigger any GPU push; a future dummy (only for an OK'd rider or a fix) needs <= 0.5 h and fits either way.
realistic_gain: 0 on public and private LB. It saves a few minutes of operator attention in the K2 submit window and closes W06's open question about reruns consuming quota.
